rationale: Approve this exact digest. It is benchmark-only label approval, with no production, qualification or rate authority. My v1 rejection of digest 0e1bf338... stands for that digest. Both v1 defects are fixed here. (1) Clipped box: c-0066 '-' (108.52-113.93) and '36"' (113.92-130.15) now bind to disjoint glyphs from native token '-36"', so no observation is duplicated. (2) Dash tokenization: I checked it against the enlarged source crop myself. The source shows spaced dashes in '6" - 12"', '25" - 36"', '>24" - 36"' and '37" - 48"', and '13" -24"' has a space only before the dash. The candidate's tokens match. Pending word geometry is now 0. I counted the 166 bound words myself. I spot-checked boxes against the 2x page render and the overlay, and they line up within about 1 pt. Adjacent overlaps are float-tiling slivers, for example 6"/- at 0.0015 pt. No retained word includes another word's ink. Caveat: the boxes are OCR advance cells, not ink-tight. They absorb whitespace, and trailing quote/comma edges may sit up to about 1 pt off. I could not measure that at sub-point precision. The seven exclusions stay: cells c-0027/30/33/45/48/51/79, rows r-0009/10/11/15/16/17/25 and their nine rate words. No misread rate text is retained.
